column.name: collection
column.remarks: Collection the entry belongs to.

column.name: status
column.remarks: Status of the entry in the source vocabulary (e.g. https://inspire.ec.europa.eu/registry/status/valid).

column.name: label
column.remarks: Label of the entry in the given language.

column.name: valid_to
column.remarks: End of the validity period; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: id_observed_property
column.remarks: Observed property.

column.name: id_process
column.remarks: Sampling or analysis process.

column.name: id_equipment
column.remarks: Equipment used for the observation (optional).

column.name: id_preparation_process
column.remarks: Sample preparation process (transport and storage); a preparation process can be shared by several datastreams.

column.name: end_result_time
column.remarks: End of the result time window; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

checkConstraint.constraint: ((id_profile_element IS NULL) OR (id_soil_profile IS NOT NULL))
checkConstraint.name: datastream_pe_requires_profile_check

checkConstraint.constraint: ((id_soil_profile IS NULL) OR (id_soil_plot IS NOT NULL) OR (id_soil_derived_object IS NOT NULL))
checkConstraint.name: datastream_profile_context_check

column.name: properties_path
column.remarks: Path of the file containing metadata about the collection (e.g. //fileuri).

column.name: end_phenomenon_time
column.remarks: End of the phenomenon time window; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: derived_profile_percentage_lower_value
column.remarks: Lower bound of the percentage range of the soil body covered by the derived profile (0-1).

column.name: derived_profile_percentage_upper_value
column.remarks: Upper bound of the percentage range of the soil body covered by the derived profile (0-1).

column.name: valid_to
column.remarks: End of the validity period; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: observation_date
column.remarks: Date of the observation the description refers to.

column.name: valid_from
column.remarks: Time when the phenomenon started to exist in the real world.

column.name: valid_to
column.remarks: Time from which the phenomenon no longer exists in the real world; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: begin_lifespan_version
column.remarks: Date and time this version of the spatial object was inserted or changed in the dataset.

column.name: end_lifespan_version
column.remarks: Date and time this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: percentage
column.remarks: Percentage of coverage (0-1).

column.name: type
column.remarks: Type of classification: HILUCS or SPECIFIC.

column.name: valid_to
column.remarks: End of the validity period; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: fao_horizon_master_1
column.remarks: FAO master horizon 1 (reference to codelist).

column.name: fao_horizon_master_2
column.remarks: FAO master horizon 2 (reference to codelist).

column.name: fao_horizon_subordinate_1
column.remarks: FAO subordinate horizon 1 (reference to codelist).

column.name: fao_horizon_subordinate_2
column.remarks: FAO subordinate horizon 2 (reference to codelist).

column.name: fao_horizon_subordinate_3
column.remarks: FAO subordinate horizon 3 (reference to codelist).

column.name: fao_horizon_vertical
column.remarks: Vertical number of the horizon.

column.name: fao_prime
column.remarks: FAO prime (reference to codelist).

table.name: group
table.remarks: Groups of users scoped to an organisation (e.g. 'ISPRA readers', 'CREA editors').

column.name: idm_external_id
column.remarks: External identifier (IDM) used to match the group with the authentication system; NULL for special groups handled at runtime.

table.name: inspire_organisation
table.remarks: 1:1 association between an INSPIRE identifier and the organisation that owns the dataset, with visibility level.

column.name: visibility
column.remarks: PUBLIC = open access. PROTECTED = access limited to groups with an explicit permission.

table.name: inspire_permission
table.remarks: Permissions granted to a group on a specific dataset.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable label (e.g. 'ISPRA - readers on Site X').

column.name: granted_by
column.remarks: External identifier (IDM) of the administrator who granted the permission.

table.name: is_based_on_observed_soil_profile
table.remarks: Association between an observed soil profile and a derived soil object.

table.name: is_based_on_soil_body
table.remarks: Association between a soil body and a derived soil object.

table.name: is_based_on_soil_derived_object
table.remarks: Association between a derived soil object and another derived soil object.

column.name: id_base
column.remarks: Reference to the non-derived profile.

column.name: id_related
column.remarks: Reference to the derived profile.

column.name: end_lifespan_version
column.remarks: Date and time this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: base_phenomenon
column.remarks: Reference to the codelist entry linking the official description of the observable property (e.g. http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/codelist/ProfileElementParameterNameValue/pHValue).

column.name: cas_code
column.remarks: CAS registry number for chemical parameters (EEA); optional.

column.name: priority
column.remarks: Priority (EEA): 1 = highest priority.

column.name: type
column.remarks: Expected data type: NUMERIC, STRING or CODELIST (EEA).

column.name: id_laboratory
column.remarks: Laboratory that performed the analysis.

column.name: result_codelist
column.remarks: Categorical result (reference to codelist); used when the result is a coded value. Numeric results are stored in result_value.

column.name: threshold_operator
column.remarks: Threshold operator of the result (reference to the THRESHOLD_OPERATOR codelist): NULL = measured value; <, >, <=, >= = limit of detection (result_value holds the LOD); ND = not detected (result_value is NULL).

column.name: phenomenon_time
column.remarks: Time the phenomenon was observed.

column.name: result_time
column.remarks: Time the result was produced.

column.name: valid_from
column.remarks: Start of the validity period (INSPIRE TM_Period).

column.name: valid_to
column.remarks: End of the validity period (INSPIRE TM_Period).

column.name: diagnostic_horizon
column.remarks: Diagnostic horizon classification (reference to codelist).

column.name: fraction_content
column.remarks: Percentage of fraction content(0-1).

column.name: particle_size_lower
column.remarks: Lower boundary of the particle size range (micron).

column.name: particle_size_upper
column.remarks: Upper boundary of the particle size range (micron).

table.name: process_document_citation
table.remarks: Many-to-many relation between process and document citation (INSPIRE documentation 0..*).

table.name: process_related_party
table.remarks: Many-to-many relation between process and related party (INSPIRE responsibleParty 0..*).

table.name: profile_element
table.remarks: Profile element: horizon or layer of a soil profile, with depth range.

column.name: profile_element_type
column.remarks: Type of profile element: horizon or layer.

column.name: layer_type
column.remarks: Type of layer; populated when profile_element_type = 'LAYER'.

column.name: end_lifespan_version
column.remarks: Date and time this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: position_name
column.remarks: Position or workplace of the individual.

column.name: role
column.remarks: Role of the related party (e.g. sampler, manager).

column.name: id_sampler
column.remarks: Sampler who performed the sampling.

column.name: soil_plot_type
column.remarks: Type of plot the soil observation is made on (e.g. trial pit, borehole, sample).

column.name: soil_plot_location
column.remarks: Location of the plot (EPSG:3035).

column.name: id_source
column.remarks: Source identifier of the plot, as provided at import time.

column.name: acquisition_type
column.remarks: Acquisition method of the coordinates (e.g. GPS).

column.name: end_lifespan_version
column.remarks: Date and time this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: wrb_soil_group
column.remarks: WRB reference soil group (reference to codelist).

column.name: id_equipment
column.remarks: Equipment used for the sampling.

column.name: id_process
column.remarks: Sampling procedure.

column.name: humus_type
column.remarks: Humus type (EEA, reference to codelist).

column.name: parent_material
column.remarks: Parent material (EEA, reference to codelist).

column.name: number_subsample
column.remarks: Number of subsamples taken from the profile.

column.name: sampling_area
column.remarks: Size of the sampling area (square metres).

column.name: sampling_area_shape
column.remarks: Shape of the sampling area (e.g. X, W).

column.name: subsampling_area
column.remarks: Area of each subsample.

column.name: valid_to
column.remarks: End of the validity period; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: end_lifespan_version
column.remarks: Date and time this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: status

column.name: biographic_region
column.remarks: Biogeographical region (EEA, reference to codelist).

column.name: eunis
column.remarks: EUNIS habitat type (EEA, reference to codelist).

column.name: maes
column.remarks: MAES ecosystem type (EEA, reference to codelist).

column.name: site_code_european
column.remarks: European site code (EEA, reference to codelist).

column.name: site_code_national
column.remarks: National site code (EEA, reference to codelist).

column.name: geometry
column.remarks: Geometry of the site (EPSG:3035).

column.name: site_name
column.remarks: Name of the site (EEA).

column.name: is_derived_from_plot
column.remarks: True when the site geometry was derived from the soil plot (fictitious site).

column.name: elevation
column.remarks: Elevation in metres (EEA).

column.name: orientation
column.remarks: Orientation in degrees (EEA); values 0-360.

column.name: slope
column.remarks: Slope in degrees (EEA); values 0-360.

column.name: monitoring_network
column.remarks: Monitoring network the site belongs to (EEA).

column.name: valid_to
column.remarks: End of the validity period; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: end_lifespan_version
column.remarks: Date and time this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: id_soil_profile
column.remarks: Reference to the soil profile the sub-sample belongs to.

table.name: soil_theme_coverage
table.remarks: INSPIRE SoilThemeCoverage: raster coverage of a soil theme.

column.name: soil_theme_parameter
column.remarks: Theme parameter of the coverage (reference to observable_property).

column.name: nomenclature
column.remarks: Codelist collection used by the coverage.

column.name: domain_extent
column.remarks: Spatial extent as a LINESTRING representing the diagonal of the bounding box: the other two corners are (x1, y2) and (x2, y1).

column.name: uri
column.remarks: URI of the raster file.

column.name: valid_to
column.remarks: End of the validity period; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

column.name: end_lifespan_version
column.remarks: Date and time this version of the spatial object was superseded or retired; 31/12/9999 means open-ended.

table.name: soil_theme_descriptive_coverage
table.remarks: INSPIRE SoilThemeDescriptiveCoverage: descriptive parameters of a coverage (e.g. resolution).

column.name: id_soil_theme_coverage
column.remarks: Reference to the parent soil theme coverage.

column.name: id_uom
column.remarks: Unit of measure of the parameter (e.g. pixel, metre, reference to unit_of_measure).

column.name: domain_extent
column.remarks: Geometric extent; if not provided it is derived from the parent coverage.

column.name: soil_theme_descriptive_parameter_name
column.remarks: Name of the descriptive parameter (e.g. resolution, scale).

column.remarks: End of the version validity.
